business_summary: Sichuan Etrol Technologies Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of automation products in China and internationally. The company offers distributed control systems, remote terminal units, expansion I/O products, and instruments, as well as specialized industrial products for the oilfield, granary, environment protection, and chemical industries; and oil and gas products, such as ground devices, measurement while drilling, natural gas processing, and environmental protection, and integration of drilling and completion, and fractu. It also provides intelligent industry products, including smart campus, intelligent environmental protection, smart granary, intelligent water, and others; digital oil and gas field, water and waste water, city gas, and coal bed methane automation business solutions; measurement while drilling, natural gas processing, city gas, oil production technology, environmental protection in oil and gas, and EPC solutions; and wisdom water, smart park, intelligent environmental protection, smart city, and smart granary solutions. In addition, the company offers technical consultation, operations and maintenance, technical training, spare parts management, and performance and upgrade services. Further, the company engages in non-residential estate leasing; property management; oilfield chemistry products and skid-mounted equipment; providing engineering construction, building installation, technical services; property management, marketing planning, social and socio-economic consultation services; development and sales of software system and cloud computing equipment. The company was formerly known as Etrol Technologies Co.,Ltd. Sichuan Etrol Technologies Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Xuzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Sichuan Etrol Technologies Co., Ltd.는 중국 및 국제적으로 자동화 제품의 연구, 개발, 제조 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 분산 제어 시스템, 원격 터미널 장치, 확장 I/O 제품 및 장비뿐만 아니라 유전, 곡물창고, 환경 보호 및 화학 산업을 위한 전문 산업 제품을 제공합니다. 지상 장치, 시추 중 측정, 천연가스 처리, 환경 보호, 시추 및 완성 통합, 파쇄 등의 석유 및 가스 제품. 또한 스마트 캠퍼스, 지능형 환경 보호, 스마트 곡창, 지능형 물 등을 포함한 지능형 산업 제품을 제공합니다. 디지털 석유 및 가스전, 상하수, 도시가스, 석탄층 메탄 자동화 비즈니스 솔루션; 시추 중 측정, 천연가스 처리, 도시 가스, 석유 생산 기술, 석유 및 가스 환경 보호, EPC 솔루션; 지혜의 물, 스마트 파크, 지능형 환경 보호, 스마트 시티, 스마트 곡창 솔루션 등이 있습니다. 또한 회사는 기술 상담, 운영 및 유지 관리, 기술 교육 등을 제공합니다.
